    customer_segment as row,

HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY customer_segment, count DESC;

# Function to calculate divergence from pivot patterns
def calculate_divergence(record, pivot_matrix):
    # Convert record to categorical distribution
    record_dist = record[['customer_segment', 'revenue_tier']].value_counts(normalize=True).reset_index()
    record_pivot = pd.pivot_table(record_dist, values='count', index='customer_segment', columns='revenue_tier', fill_value=0)
    
    # Calculate distance from pivot matrix
    distance = pairwise_distances(record_pivot, pivot_matrix, metric='cosine')[0]
    return distance

# Get sample of records for efficiency
sample_query = "SELECT * FROM customer360__customer_value_analysis LIMIT 1000"
sample_df = pd.read_sql(sample_query, conn)

# Calculate divergences
divergences = sample_df.apply(lambda x: calculate_divergence(x, pivot_matrix), axis=1)
sample_df['divergence'] = divergences

top_divergent = sample_df.nlargest(25, 'divergence')
